summary.text: Joe Lombardo is the incumbent Republican Governor of Nevada, seeking a second term. A former Clark County sheriff, he was elected in 2022. His campaign highlights his record on education, health care, public safety and the economy; he has pledged no new taxes, vetoed a record number of bills from the Democratic-controlled Legislature, and backed a 2024 ballot question requiring voter ID.

paragraphs.text: Lombardo earned a bachelor's degree and a master's degree in crisis management from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas.
He served in the U.S. Army, Army Reserve and Nevada National Guard from 1980 to 1986, then joined the Las Vegas Metropolitan Police Department in 1988 and rose through the ranks.
After 26 years with the department, Lombardo was elected Clark County sheriff in 2014 and re-elected in 2018, serving until 2022.
He was elected governor in 2022, took office in January 2023, and is the Republican nominee for re-election.
